class.name: AudioStreamPlaybackMIDIBase
class.brief_description: Abstract base of the MIDI playback classes.
class.description: Holds the synth settings shared by [AudioStreamPlaybackMIDI] and [AudioStreamPlaybackMIDISequencer]. They mirror the [AudioStreamPlayer] parameters of the same names and are read when playback starts.

members.member: Index of the embedded instrument bank. Takes effect when playback starts.
OPL3 emulator backend. Takes effect when playback starts.
Number of four-operator channels, or [code]-1[/code] for automatic. Takes effect when playback starts.
Whether full-range brightness is enabled. Takes effect when playback starts.
Number of emulated OPL3 chips. Takes effect when playback starts.
Volume scaling model. Takes effect when playback starts.
